name: Uncommon Life
source:
This is the story of a boy who escapes from his city in search of adventures but returns home, invited by the king to his castle, he meets his daughters and wife, with his faithful companion the elf, both will live a dramatic adventure and above all, full of lust.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/user/about?u=11326644]Patreon[/url]]
